system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global point-event catalog of reported rainfall-triggered landslides.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Reported landslide-event records spanning 1970-2019 (from the dataset title); individual features also carry event-level date fields such as `event_date` and `created_da`.
data_description.temporal_unit: Per-event timestamp fields in feature attributes
data_description.data_type_numeric: Attribute schema is mixed; inspect property fields before numeric aggregation

sample_properties.event_desc: A couple died after being buried in a landslide.   Bharat Rai, 58, of Jimigaon in Kulung-6 and his 54-year-old wife Rammani died after the house they were living in was buried in the landslides triggered by heavy rainfall last night.

property_semantics_hint.event_date: Reported date and time of the landslide event.
property_semantics_hint.event_titl: Short event title/headline in the catalog.
property_semantics_hint.event_desc: Free-text narrative description of the reported landslide event.
property_semantics_hint.fatality_c: Fatality count reported for the event when available.
property_semantics_hint.landslid_2: Sampled categorical landslide-size or severity descriptor from the source table.
property_semantics_hint.country_na: Country name field when populated in the catalog.
property_semantics_hint.location_d: Location description field when populated in the catalog.
property_semantics_hint.source_nam: Source publication or reporting outlet name when populated.

data_description.important_note: Description fields below were populated from an actual Earth Engine FeatureCollection probe. The prompt preserves the sampled event attributes and treats the catalog as an event table rather than a continuous raster or regular time series.
analytical_capabilities: Combination with slope or rainfall layers

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Event-level categorical/text attributes plus count fields such as `fatality_c`.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use `event_date`, event severity descriptors, and count-like fields directly from the feature table; do not coerce narrative fields into numeric measures.

data_description.data_source: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
